title: Harmonic current spectrum
description: Harmonic current source spectrum: magnitude (percent of fundamental) and phase per order 2..50. The library spectra are assumed-typical CuratedPlaceholder [VERIFY]; the 6- and 12-pulse spectra are computed 100/h. The -g5 types are ENA EREC G5 Issue 5 (docs/reference S139) Table B.3 emission assumptions, pp.99-100 (S3 G02).

sourceType.description: Library spectrum the source starts from (HarmonicSourceLibrary.ByType), or custom.

fundamentalCurrentPu.description: Fundamental (reference) current of the source, pu on the system base.

codeDefaults.consumer: CLI harmonic study synthetic 6-pulse source without --spectra (CliDefaults.DefaultHarmonicSourcePu)
